author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: अहं गां भूमिमाविश्य ओजसा स्वशक्त्या भूतानि धारयामि । अमृतरसात्मकः सौम्यत्वात्सोमनामा सोमगः सन्सर्वा ओषधीः सस्यादीनि पुष्णामि वर्धयामि च ॥१५.१३॥
translation:
Having entered into the earth I support all beings by My own power, and having become Soma, the embodiment of Amrita Rasa, I nourish all plants. (13)
V. Having become Soma: under the name of Soma so-called because of gentleness. I enable all the plants and herbs to grow and develop. (13)
